sources.finding: addChunk reserves size plus a full chunk before grow checks against maxCapacity; a remaining partial chunk can therefore be rejected even when logical output fits.
zlibSyncImpl sends ordinary calls to native zlibSync; info:true calls processChunk with the synchronous engine instead.

relatedPatch.finding: The inspected patch caps addChunk reserve to maxCapacity and adds exact and near-limit decompression tests after output buffer growth. No upstream patch or runtime update is installed here.

earlierIssue.finding: The previously reported exact-limit workaround of one extra byte does not cover the growth-boundary failure reproduced in the current pinned runtime.
